name: Shelly Dimmer Gen3 (EU)

radios.note: Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n and Bluetooth (KB lists a Bluetooth ID).

matter.note: Shelly says Gen3 devices are built to be upgradable to Matter, but its Matter lists do not name this dimmer and no CSA page for it was found. A CSA certificate ID for it showed only in a sidebar, so unconfirmed.

apple_home.note: No Matter certification confirmed and no Shelly page names Apple Home for this model.

google_home.note: Shelly's spec table marks Google Smart Home traits as supported.

alexa.note: Shelly's spec table marks Amazon Alexa capabilities as supported.

smartthings.note: Shelly's spec table marks Samsung SmartThings capabilities as supported.

home_assistant.note: Official Shelly integration with local push.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device with its own access point and web interface.

localControl.note: Built-in web interface plus local push in Home Assistant; Shelly lists scripting, MQTT and webhooks.

switchForm.note: Compact dimming controller that sits behind an existing wall switch.

dimmer.note: Trailing-edge dimmer for dimmable LED, incandescent and halogen loads.

neutralRequired.note: Works with or without neutral. Without neutral and without a Bypass the minimum load is 20 W.

summary: The Shelly Dimmer Gen3 is a single-channel trailing-edge dimmer module for the box behind an existing wall switch. It works with or without a neutral wire and handles up to 200 W. It runs on Wi-Fi with Bluetooth, has a local web interface, and connects to Alexa, Google, SmartThings and Home Assistant.
caveats: Without a neutral wire the minimum load is 20 W unless you add Shelly's Bypass; low-wattage LEDs may flicker otherwise.
Power measurement is not available without a neutral wire.
Matter and Apple Home support are unconfirmed for this model.
Not compatible with rotary dimmer switches; LED lamps are limited to 150 W and incandescent or halogen to 200 W.
